title: Prologue
content: "I've decided to get married."
The moment I heard those words, I realized I was a reincarnator.
You might wonder how I could come to that conclusion from such a statement, but I used to be an ordinary salaryman.
I lived each day without confidence, unable to confess my feelings to the childhood friend who was now telling me about her marriage.
In life, I was just an average existence, like anyone else.
I don't know if it was because I hesitated or if she already had a boyfriend, but I was informed of her marriage by my childhood friend.
It's a miserable story.
I had always liked her but couldn't even confess.
This was the second time I received a marriage announcement from a childhood friend, and it brought back bitter memories of my past life.
"Marriage? Who are you marrying?"
I thought it was a natural question.
After finishing my work for the day, I came to my regular dining hall with my childhood friends.
In this reincarnated world, I was working as an adventurer.
I formed a party with two childhood friends and had dinner at our regular dining hall, located between the Adventurers Guild and the inn.
After work, we would drink ale with our companions, reflecting on the day and distributing our rewards.
The lively atmosphere of the tavern and the rare private room prepared for us.
I frequently used this place to protect my beautiful childhood friends from the barbaric men.
After finishing our meal and satisfying our hunger, I suddenly received Cynthia's marriage announcement.
"It's someone you don't know, Brother Salt."
Cynthia, with her dull yellow hair cut to shoulder length, had grown into a beautiful woman, her feminine figure enough to captivate countless men.
Even though I thought of her as a childhood friend, I had started to see Cynthia as a woman.
That's why, the moment I heard the marriage announcement, I froze, shocked enough to remember that I was in another world.
I had a past life, and the situation of Cynthia getting married overlapped with that memory.
"Marriage... I see, congratulations."
"Yes, thank you, Brother Salt."
Seeing Cynthia's happy smile made me realize that once again, I couldn't do anything when my childhood friend was getting married.
And now, in this life too, I was just someone who could only accept it.
No, I had no reason to oppose it.
In this life, I was meant to protect and nurture her as her brother.
It was only natural to accept it.
"I'm also being scouted by the Knight Order! Isn't that amazing?"
The other childhood friend, Asha, who had been listening to the marriage talk, dropped another bombshell without any sign of surprise.
She had a bad habit of speaking without thinking deeply about things.
Asha, with her cheerful personality and lively ponytail, meant no harm.
In fact, she was proudly boasting about being scouted by the Knight Order.
She had always admired the kingdom's Knight Order and was understandably proud to have been scouted.
"So, I want to disband our party starting today."
Please consider my feelings when suddenly being told by my childhood friends, who I had thought of as little sisters, that they wanted to disband our adventurer party.
The shock of being informed of the disbandment right after realizing I was a reincarnator was greater than the realization itself.
"Asha, that's amazing. Your dream has come true."
"Yeah, it's all thanks to you, Brother Salt. Now I can become a knight like my father!"
Asha's father was a knight in the kingdom. She had dreamed of becoming a knight like him since she was young.
Our village was devastated five years ago by a massive monster attack.
I managed to escape to the royal capital with the two of them, thanks to our parents desperately trying to keep us alive.
Since then, I had worked hard as an adventurer to raise the two of them.
"Thank you so much for everything, Brother Salt."
Cynthia expressed her gratitude politely.
Cynthia's magic and Asha's swordsmanship had allowed the three of us to survive this far.
I might have been a burden to the two of them since I wasn't much help in combat.
What are you talking about?
We're like siblings, right?
You two have grown into wonderful adults, each walking your own path.
There's nothing more joyful than that!
While I tried to sound strong, I buried my feelings and patted their heads.
Today, our adventurer party of three would disband.
It would take me a little time to accept that, but it was for their happiness.
"If we're disbanding the party, I'll divide the funds we've saved up into three equal parts!"
After returning from the dining hall to the inn, we distributed the party funds and items we had accumulated.
"Brother Salt, isn't this too much?"
I had managed the money we earned as a leader, and I decided to give them a bit more than a third.
"Consider it a congratulatory gift. I can't give you any more than this."
"Thank you, Brother Salt."
Cynthia bowed deeply. Asha, who wasn't good with money, seemed unconcerned about the amount.
"What are you going to do from now on, Brother Salt?"
"Me? Well, I was thinking of leaving the royal capital and heading to the Corias territory."
I wanted to start anew in a faraway place to escape the pain of unrequited love.
I wasn't skilled in combat like the two of them.
I planned to earn my living through healing magic.
"The Corias territory?"
Yeah, I've heard that miasma is spreading over there.
Since I have a holy attribute, purifying the miasma should be a piece of cake.
"Brother Salt's healing magic feels much better than the healing attribute magic from the Healer Guild."
"Not in that sense! I mean purifying!"
Did Asha mistake me for her personal massage therapist or something?
"Yes, it does feel a bit strange."
When Cynthia sighed with a sultry air, I felt embarrassed.
Although I received high praise from the two of them for my holy attribute healing magic, it wasn't that impressive.

Compared to the healing techniques used by the Healer Guild's healing attribute, it took longer to heal, and there were even strange rumors that it felt oddly good, leading female adventurers to dislike it.
"Enough about me. Asha, you need to learn to get up on your own."
"Ugh, I'm fine now!"
"Hehe, Asha is a sleepyhead."
The days we had supported each other were coming to an end.
While it was sad, my desire to celebrate their new beginnings was stronger.
"How about we sleep together for the first time in a while?"
"That sounds nice. We used to sleep together often when we came to the royal capital."
When the two of them made such a proposal, I shook my head.
The fifteen-year-old girls were slender and still children.
But now, they were different.
They had developed into beautiful young women.
I couldn't imagine being able to sleep in the same bed with such two beautiful girls.
Give me a break.
With how poorly you two sleep, I wouldn't be able to get a wink of sleep.
Now, now, our party is disbanded here.
From tomorrow, we'll each walk our own paths.
You two are adults now.
Do your best.
I chased them out while saying my farewell, patting their heads one last time.
"Brother Salt, you're so stingy! I could sleep with such beautiful girls!"
"Hehe, that's exactly why it's not okay, Asha. Thank you so much for everything, Brother Salt."
"Yeah, it's refreshing to see both of my little sisters leaving at the same time!"
Cynthia's face also showed the sadness of parting.
Thanks to you, Brother Salt, we've been able to keep going.
I truly appreciate the encouragement, courage, and support you've given us.
I felt like a father sending his daughter off to marry.
I was glad to have fallen in love with Cynthia.
Oh no!
I felt like I might cry.
I hope I’m not actually crying.
That would be way too embarrassing.
Whoever she chose to be happy with, I wanted to bless her.
Yeah, we're family.
The bond between the three of us is eternal.
If you ever find yourselves in trouble, don't hesitate to consult me.
"Yes! Thank you, Brother Salt!"
"Thank you, Brother Salt."
"Hey, we made a great team, didn't we?"
"Of course! If it weren't for you, my body would have been unable to fight anymore."
"That's right. You purified the poison and curses for me, Brother Salt."
Haha, you both are exaggerating.
And I didn't ask you to praise me.
I just thought we were the best team.
That's why I asked.
Asha's swordsmanship defeated so many monsters and helped us, and Cynthia's precise magic, though not flashy, saved us countless times.
As we reminisced about our past achievements and memories, the reality of our parting sank in.
Parting comes to everyone, but today was that day for us.
"Once again, Brother Salt..."
"Brother Salt."
The two of them looked at each other and said in unison.
"Thank you very much!"
Thus, the trio of close childhood friends ended their journey as adventurers to walk their separate paths.
The next morning, I checked out of the inn early and headed to the Adventurers Guild.
After saying goodbye yesterday, I felt a bit embarrassed to do it again today, so I decided to leave the inn early.
At the Adventurers Guild, I informed them of Cynthia's marriage announcement and Asha's enlistment in the royal capital's Knight Order, and I announced the disbandment of our party.
Milia, who always handled the reception in the royal capital, was one of the most beautiful women in the Adventurers Guild.
"I see, thank you for your hard work until now."
When I informed Milia about the disbandment, she bowed her head politely.
"Haha, I'm not retiring or anything."
"Of course not. I expect you to keep doing your best, Lord Salt!"
"Hehe, just kidding."
Even though we were only a year apart, I could never bring myself to look down on Milia.
Her figure was so enticing that it was hard to focus on our conversation without being distracted by her curves.
In my past life, I was so shy that just looking at an attractive woman made me feel like I might have a nosebleed.
I tried my best to focus on her eyes while talking, but Milia's voice was sweet and gentle.
I was surprised to hear that Cynthia is getting married.
I thought for sure she would become your bride.
Didn't you know anything?
"Haha, I guess it's because we're not really family, huh? I didn't know anything."
"Come on, that's not a nice way to put it. But it's strange. I thought she was devoted to you."
"It seems I was the only one who thought that."
I couldn't help but let my true feelings slip out. Milia smiled gently at me.
"You're going to be okay. Would you like to go out with me?"
"Haha, someone like me wouldn't be a good match for you. I think you're the most beautiful woman in the royal capital."
"Hehe, that's exactly what I mean."
Milia murmured something under her breath.
"Huh? Did you say something?"
"Nothing. So, what are you going to do from now on, Lord Salt?"
Milia had taught me many things since I came to the royal capital.
It had been about five years since we met, and she had helped me a lot when I first became an adventurer.
She was the person I could talk to most comfortably in the royal capital.
That's why I wanted to express my gratitude and say goodbye to her.
"I was thinking of heading to the remote Corias territory."
"The Corias territory? That's quite far out."
"Yes. Since I have a holy attribute, I can only purify miasma. I've heard that it's increasing over there."
"I see, so you're going to where people are waiting for your help. You're always like that."
"Huh?"
"Nothing. Just be careful. If I have the chance, I'll also go to Corias, so let's meet again then."
"Yes! Thank you for everything until now."
After finishing my farewell with Milia, I said goodbye to my acquaintances at the Adventurers Guild.
I considered the royal capital my second hometown.
I had many encounters here.
But I decided to leave the royal capital where Cynthia and Asha lived.
I didn't want to live with lingering attachments forever.
It was time for a fresh start in a new land.
After leaving the Adventurers Guild, I decided to head straight to the Corias territory.
There was a possibility of encountering monsters, but as long as I prepared items to ward them off, it shouldn't be a problem.
If I got tired along the way, I could rest in a nearby town.
"Well, it'll work out somehow. I just have to enjoy my solo journey."
It felt like a trip to heal from heartbreak, but I never expected to hear marriage announcements from my childhood friends twice.
But, it's all about perspective.
I don't know why I was reincarnated into another world, but I was given a chance to start over.
The memories of living as Salt in this world remain intact, and there are no differences between my past life and this one.
Traveling in a world where I could use magic had a certain romantic appeal.
It would take about four days to reach Corias by carriage.
If I walked, it would take a week, so I prepared for camping out.
It's normal for adventurers to leave without any send-off. This is the path I chose. I would live firmly as Salt.
The bond with my childhood friends had been severed. I would start my life anew.
The journey in this other world was more enjoyable than I expected.
I set up a tent for camping, arranged magic-repelling items, ate the preserved food I had stocked up, and gazed at the beautiful starry sky.
This journey continued for about five days, and I finally entered the Corias territory.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vhqjpdS.jpeg
"Ahh!"
Just after crossing the border, I heard the screams of several women.
I also heard the sound of horses galloping away, and I approached the direction of the screams to hide and observe.
It seemed I was already getting wrapped up in trouble.
There, skeletons and ghosts were attacking a carriage.
Undead monsters tend to appear more frequently when miasma increases.
Moreover, the sheer number of them suggested they were being controlled by a high-ranking necromancer.
It seemed the increase in miasma in the Corias territory was having an effect.
"Traveling companions are a blessing!"
I had no option but to help. I steeled myself and decided to assist.
One carriage was surrounded by skeletons and ghosts, taking damage.
I needed to divert the monsters' attention away from the carriage.
"Hey! Is anyone injured?"
As I shouted, a ghost, a mist-like monster, turned to look at me.
In that moment, I caught sight of a knight fighting to protect the carriage.
Her silver hair shone beautifully, and our eyes met for a brief moment.
I was momentarily captivated by her beauty but quickly slapped my cheeks to regain focus.
Now was not the time to be mesmerized by a female knight.
I activated my holy attribute magic against the approaching swarm of ghosts.
"Holy Arrow!"
When I took the adventurer aptitude test, I discovered I had an affinity for holy attribute magic.
Holy attribute is one of the thirteen magical attributes.
The eight natural attributes are Earth, Water, Fire, Wind, Lightning, Ice, Light, and Darkness.
The rare attributes, known as No Attribute, Healing, Holy, Death, and Time-Space, are said to have fewer people with affinities compared to the eight natural attributes.
Holy attribute is one of the rare attributes and is particularly effective in battles against undead.
I eliminated the ghosts one after another with Holy Arrow.
It didn't work well against anything other than undead.
However, I could purify miasma and toxins, so places with high miasma were where I could truly shine.
This was my greatest weapon as a reincarnated person.
I drew my dagger, enhanced it with holy attribute magic, and slashed at the skeletons.
*Clatter, clatter, clatter!*
"Hmph!"
Adventurer parties typically consist of four to six members, but we had been adventuring as a trio of childhood friends.
Cynthia had disliked the idea of adding more members, so we had learned to handle everything as three.
To continue adventuring with the two of them, I had acquired skills as a thief in addition to healing magic and purification.
Thief skills include dagger techniques, scouting, trap disarming, and sensing presence, with my main role being to support the two of them.
For me, the dagger had become a martial art that could take down skeletons even alone.
As I reduced the number of enemies, I made my way to the female knight protecting the carriage.
"I'm an adventurer! I'm here to help!"
When I called out, the silver-haired knight took a moment to catch her breath before turning to respond.
"Thank you for your help."
Her exhaustion was evident on her face, and I could see her relief at our joining forces.
There are seriously injured people inside the carriage.
The others left to escort the protected ones to safety.
I was acting as bait to draw the enemies away.
More like a sacrificial lamb.
I'm an adventurer who can use holy attribute magic.
I'm well-suited for fighting undead.
Let's finish this quickly.
There should be a necromancer nearby.
If we take them down, all the monsters will disappear.
Do you know where they are?
"Holy attribute! That's reassuring. I know where the necromancer is."
"Really?"
Necromancers often hide while controlling the monsters they summon. Knowing their location was a huge advantage.
"Over there."
She pointed in the opposite direction from where I had come, and I saw a crowned wight floating in the air.
"What!? Is that a White King?"
I was taken aback by the unexpected high-ranking opponent.
I had imagined a necromancer like a Wight Magician, but it seemed I was up against an even higher-tier creature.
The amount of miasma saturating Corias was significant.
"Understood. I'll take care of that one. Can you handle the skeletons?"
"Of course."
With my back entrusted to the female knight, I readied my dagger and charged toward the White King.
As I cut down the skeletons in front of me, I glanced back and caught a glimpse of the knight's high skill level.
Her weapon was a sword and a small shield.
She skillfully wielded them, with high precision in her attacks and solid defense.
"Now!"
The knight's voice echoed across the battlefield.
She had cleared away all the skeletons protecting the White King.
"Impressive... Let's finish this! Sacred Cross!"
As I activated the higher-level holy attribute magic, pure power enveloped the White King, and purifying light filled the area.
"White King, vanish!"
The powerful holy attribute magic, using half my magic power, began to purify the White King.
It seemed the White King hadn't expected me to use holy attribute magic.
The undead it had summoned began to disappear one after another.
"Phew, that went well..."
When I turned around, the female knight had also finished dealing with the other monsters.
"Where are the injured?"
When I asked her, she pointed wearily toward the inside of the carriage.
Inside was a small, cute brown-haired female knight, who appeared to have been deeply slashed by a skeleton.
She was bleeding heavily and seemed to be losing consciousness.
"Do you have a blood replenishing agent?"
"Yes, in the first aid kit."
"Good, let me have that."
"How do I give it to her?"
It seemed she didn't know how to handle someone who was unconscious.
I took some water and the blood replenishing agent into my mouth and poured it into the injured knight's mouth.
As I administered the blood replenishing agent, I began to cast Healing magic.
However, holy attribute healing magic takes longer compared to healing attribute magic, so I felt a sense of urgency as I continued the treatment.
The silver-haired knight let out an admiring voice, but I calmly responded.
"If it were a healing attribute healer, they could heal her faster, but I'm a holy attribute user. It just takes time."
As I watched the wound slowly heal, I began to feel my magic power depleting.
"Are you okay!? You look pale."
"I'm out of magic power. I just need to rest for a bit."
"Thank you. Please take your time to rest. You are our lifesaver. I will repay this debt as a knight."
Hearing her words of gratitude, I lost consciousness right there.
When I woke up, I felt a soft sensation against my cheek. It was warm and smelled nice.
"Ugh!? Huh?"
"Are you awake?"
In my hazy vision, I saw a silver-haired beauty.
"Whoa!?"
"I didn't mean to startle you. I know my thighs are firm from training, but that reaction is a bit shocking."
A knee pillow from a silver-haired knight was the best!
But I had never experienced being knee-pillow'd by such an extraordinary beauty, so I was just genuinely surprised.
In my current situation, I finally understood that I had been rude to her.
"Knee pillow? Oh, no, it's not that I dislike it; I was just surprised, and I actually appreciate it!?"
Hehe, after you collapsed, my companions returned with reinforcements.
We are currently heading toward the town where we live.
"Reinforcements?"
Indeed, the carriage was swaying, confirming that we were moving.
Looking outside, I could see the castle town of Corias.
"The capital of the Corias territory?"
It would have taken two more days on foot, but we had covered the distance by carriage in a single day.
Yes.
We belong to the Fourth Knight Order of Corias.
We were providing escort for Lady Rana Corias, the acting lord and sister of the count, during a border inspection.
I never expected to be attacked by a White King controlling undead, but you saved our lives.
The beautiful knight before me reported the situation with a wry smile.
I never imagined I would help the escort of the acting lord.
"Let me introduce myself again. I am Krush, the vice-captain of the Fourth Knight Order."
"Oh, uh, I'm Salt, an adventurer."
Krush reached out for a handshake and introduced herself.
I arrived in the castle town of Corias with Krush and got off the carriage.
Outside, the members of the Fourth Knight Order were lined up on either side to welcome us, all of them female knights.
"Huh?"
As I was surprised, the female knights all saluted in unison.
Everyone, thank you for your hard work.
I let my guard down, thinking this was just an escort mission.
I truly apologize.
I should have paid with my life, but thanks to this adventurer, Lord Salt, our lives were saved.
Lord Salt, thank you so much for saving the lives of me and my comrades.
"Thank you very much!"
The female members of the knight order all expressed their gratitude in unison.
I was overwhelmed and unsure how to respond.
Just then, a blonde beauty stepped forward from the center of the line.
If Krush was a cool and refreshing beauty with silver hair, the beautiful blonde woman approaching from the center resembled the goddess of the sun.
With a bust so large that I had never encountered in my life, she exuded both glamour and elegance as she approached.
It felt like she was there to kill my innocence.
I felt like I might have a nosebleed just from looking at her without even seeing her breasts.
"Are you the adventurer, Lord Salt?"
"Yes! I'm the adventurer Salt!"
I was desperate.
I stared into her eyes, not daring to look away for even a moment.
If I shifted my gaze even a millimeter, I would be entranced.
An enormous weapon called a bust was on display right in front of me.
Thank you for saving me and the members of the Fourth Knight Order, including myself.
I am Lady Rana Corias, the sister of the lord and the steward.
Lady Rana lifted her skirt elegantly to greet me, and I closed my eyes and offered a knightly salute.
When knights and commoners greet royalty or nobility, there are certain manners to follow.
This time, as an adventurer warrior, I followed the knightly etiquette, closing my eyes and placing my hand on my chest and sword as I bowed my head.
Your words are too kind.
I can only think of it as a divine intervention that I happened to pass by and was able to save you.
Though I was nervous, I followed the proper etiquette and accepted her greeting.
I was glad I had studied how to interact with nobles while being an adventurer.
As I had learned during my salaryman days, when in Rome, do as the Romans do.
"Wonderful. That was a knight's greeting."
When I opened my eyes to her sweet and soft voice, there was an overwhelming presence that felt like a bomb named heaven, and once I looked, I couldn't take my eyes off her.
That's why I wanted to feel her grace and dignity at this moment.
I did my best to avoid being rude and continued to gaze into her eyes.
If I looked away, I would die!
The existence of a dress that could kill my innocence truly existed.
Her eyes were also a dangerous territory.
I felt like I might be sucked into those beautiful eyes, but I never averted my gaze.
"You are a very humble and sincere person."
Lady Rana smiled and conveyed her evaluation of me.
However, I was at a loss as to how to respond from here.
I continued to stare into her eyes, locking gazes with Lady Rana.
"May I express my gratitude as well?"
"Yes, of course, Lady Freina."
A woman who appeared from behind Lady Rana had short, bright red hair and large, red eyes, exuding a cool beauty.
I was momentarily captivated by her dignified presence.
Lord Salt, allow me to introduce myself again.
I am Freina Alban, the captain of the Fourth Knight Order.
Thank you for saving the lives of my comrades.
As I admired her graceful demeanor, I felt like I might be entranced, but I returned the courtesy with the same respect.
"Yes! I gratefully accept your thanks, Captain."
When I responded to her words, Lady Freina smiled brightly.
"Lord Salt, you must have traveled quite a bit as an adventurer."
"Yes, that's right. It took me about five days to get here from the royal capital."
"Wow, that's impressive!"
I apologize for making you worry.
You must be tired.
We have prepared a place for you to stay.
Please rest there today.
We can discuss future matters tomorrow.
After Lady Rana, Lady Freina informed me that they had arranged accommodations for me and suggested we talk about future matters tomorrow.
"Future matters?"
I didn't know what awaited me, but I was grateful for their offer, as I had planned to look for an inn after arriving in the castle town of Corias.
"I understand. Thank you for everything."
"Then, Mei, can you guide him?"
"Yes, of course!"
The one designated by Captain Freina was a small-statured member with chestnut hair.
She was the one who had collapsed in the carriage.
"You!?"
"Lord Salt! Thank you so much for saving me back then! I owe my life to you!"
Despite her small size, she had a cute appearance, and her disproportionately large chest jutted out like a rocket.
I felt my gaze drifting for a moment, but I desperately redirected my eyes to Mei's face.
"I'm Salt."
"I'm Mei! I'll guide you to the inn!"
"Ah, please do."
The place she led me to was the best inn in Corias.
It was a luxurious inn where nobles would stay, and I couldn't hide my nervousness.
Then, I'll come to pick you up tomorrow around noon!
You can walk around the town in the morning, but I would appreciate it if you could return by noon.
"Ah, okay, I understand."
It seemed they already had plans for tomorrow.
Even so, I was overwhelmed by the luxuriousness of the room.
I wanted to focus solely on relaxing and recovering from my fatigue.
After seeing Mei off, I quickly took off my gear and collapsed onto the bed to rest.
"Wow, this high-end inn bed is amazing!"
It was the ultimate luxury I had always wanted to experience.
As an adventurer, just being able to sleep in a bed was bliss.
I understood that, but now that my life as Salt had been longer, my past life was nothing more than a memory.
I was now an adventurer with a holy attribute affinity, and the main job of adventurers in this world was to hunt monsters.
Because life and death were constantly at stake, it was a joy to see Asha secure a stable job as a knight and Cynthia get married.
Once I sorted out my feelings, I could visit Cynthia to congratulate her.
As I pondered these thoughts, I drifted off to sleep.
...Knock, knock.
"Huh? Yes?"
I seemed to have fallen asleep without realizing it. The sound of knocking on the door woke me up.
"Excuse me. I have come from the Corias Count House to take your measurements."
Measurements!? My dazed mind struggled to comprehend as I opened the door to find a white-haired gentleman bowing.
Yes.
I have been instructed by Lady Rana Corias to tailor an outfit for you to wear at tomorrow's lunch.
It is to be suitable for the occasion.
"What!? I can't refuse that..."
I'm not fond of formal attire.
Besides, even a single noble outfit is quite expensive.
While I saved on lodging, I want to avoid unnecessary expenses in the future.
All costs will be covered by the Corias family.
I would not recommend turning down an invitation from a noble.
Unless you wish to make an enemy of the nobility, of course?
Overwhelmed by the dignified tailor, I ended up agreeing to have a tuxedo made for formal occasions and a more casual outfit suitable for a noble.
Additionally, he asked about my preferences for colors and would prepare several outfits.
The measuring process took about an hour until the tailor finally left.
"I will deliver the outfit for lunch tomorrow morning."
As the tailor exited the room, there was another knock at the door.
"What now?"
"I have brought your dinner."
"That's a relief!"
I missed lunch due to the battle earlier, and my stomach was growling now.
"May I come in?"
"Huh? Can't you just hand it to me here?"
"No, our hotel chef will serve it while cooking."
"Seriously?"
"Yes. During that time, I will also instruct you on table manners."
"Haha..."
I spent the next two hours learning dinner etiquette while eating my meal.
To be honest, even though the food was supposed to be delicious, I couldn't remember the taste at all.
I only remembered to use the knife and fork from the outside in.
...Knock, knock.
"What now?"
"Excuse me, Lord Salt."
The one who entered was a maid.
"Um, who are you?"
"I am the one in charge of the bath. I will prepare it for you."
"That's a relief!"
Unlike dinner, there were no manners to worry about.
The maid tossed flames she conjured into a tub filled with water.
It seemed she was using fire magic to heat the water.
I didn't care about the details. I just wanted to enjoy a nice bath and go to sleep.
"The bath is ready."
"Thank you. Well then..."
"No, I will wash your body!"
"Huh?"
"That's my job!"
It seems that nobles never bathe alone.
Therefore, a body-washing maid is assigned to the hotel’s private bath.
She removed her maid outfit and changed into a bathing suit!?
Her white skin and beautiful figure were revealed.
What followed was a display of professional washing techniques.
Honestly, it felt incredibly good!
No, not in a weird way, but truly comfortable.
It appeared I had been quite dirty since I hadn't bathed since leaving the royal capital.
I was thoroughly cleaned, and all the grime was washed away.
While soaking in the tub, I had my hair washed and even received a shoulder massage; it was pampering at its finest.
High-class accommodations for nobles are amazing.
"Well then, I will take my leave."
The service included drying my hair after wiping my body.
Wrapped in a luxurious bathrobe, all that was left was to sleep.
"This is amazing; the bed feels so good."
I fell asleep in less than three seconds.
